hardware_crypto_engine.cipher: AES-XTS (XEX-based Tweakable Block Cipher with Ciphertext Stealing)

data_streaming_paths.H2F: Host-to-Flash: High-bandwidth streaming encryption during NVMe Write DMA
data_streaming_paths.F2H: Flash-to-Host: Real-time streaming decryption during NVMe Read DMA

per_block_tweak_generation.security_property: Guarantees identical data written across different LBAs or namespaces produces distinct ciphertext on NAND flash

key_ladder_integration.root_of_trust: Secure Enclave Processor (SEP) UID / GID hardware key ladder
key_ladder_integration.unwrapping_mechanism: Effaceable Storage (Namespace 7) provides encrypted Key Encryption Keys (KEK)
key_ladder_integration.key_slot_programming: Programmed over secure internal bus into dedicated hardware key slots in 0x17dd47c00

error_registers.name: status_reg
error_registers.description: Global cipher engine status and pipeline ready flag

error_registers.name: load_err_info0
error_registers.description: Key slot descriptor load failure info

error_registers.name: load_err_info1
error_registers.description: Tweak generator overflow and alignment fault flags

error_registers.name: h2f_err
error_registers.description: Host-to-Flash streaming data beat parity mismatch

error_registers.name: f2h_err
error_registers.description: Flash-to-Host streaming data beat decryption fault

multi_tier_wear_leveling.bands: Multi-tier Wear Leveling Bands (W: Wear Level Bands)
multi_tier_wear_leveling.slc_tier: Fast on-demand single-level cell cache (oSLC, BI: BLKS(SLC))
multi_tier_wear_leveling.tlc_tier: High-density triple-level cell bulk storage (BU: BLKS(MLC/TLC))
multi_tier_wear_leveling.wear_thresholds: Dynamic stepover limits (SoMx: Maximal stepovers, SoAvg: Average stepovers)

bad_block_retirement.factory_bad_blocks: Preserved in persistent bootloader NAND defect tables
bad_block_retirement.grown_bad_blocks: Monitored at runtime via GBB counter (GB: total number GBBs)
bad_block_retirement.retirement_policy: Blocks exceeding maximum uncorrectable ECC error thresholds (UE num ueccs) or erase retry counts are immediately marked retired and excluded from band allocation

read_disturb_mitigation.sampling_engine: Hardware Read Disturb Sampler (RDS: Sectors read due to RD sampler)
read_disturb_mitigation.action: Autonomous proactive background relocation to new block followed by block erase

hmb_dma_arbitration.iommu_protection: SART Coastguard v4 filter window at 0x17dcc0000
hmb_dma_arbitration.bandwidth_governor: ans-af-bw-threshold dynamic arbitration protecting CPU DRAM latency
